mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CATEGORY (user_id, category_name, description, sort_order, common_yn, use_yn, create_user, create_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryName}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{commonYn}, #{useYn}, #{createUser}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE CATEGORY SET user_id = #{userId}, category_name = #{categoryName}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, common_yn = #{commonYn}, use_yn = #{useYn}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_date = NOW() WHERE category_sq = #{categorySq}
